correctness.rationale: For all n>=2, every cut pattern has packet-reward identities F=sum odd(length) and I=sum binom(length,2). Product-measure Harris and a strict coordinate influence give negative unconditional covariance. Uniform fixed-m compositions, exact weak-composition factorial moments and a positive regression increment give nonnegative conditional covariance and exact equality range. Geometric renewal-reward FCLT and explicit finite exponential moments establish the bivariate Gaussian covariance and correlation. The actual standalone checker completed 536 exact-rational assertions for sizes 2..12 plus moment identities; computation is supporting finite evidence, not an infinite proof.

value.rationale: The packet count is directly observable as n minus the descent count. The result classifies the opposite unconditional and fixed-packet conditional association signs for all n,p,m, gives sharp degeneracy boundaries and exact conditional regression, and quantifies the fluctuation limit. The natural observable dependence paradox is not a textbook restatement of a general CLT or a small arbitrary finite example.
